package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-errors-problems/lib/problem"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-standard-config/lib/standardconfig"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-standard-config/testhelper"
)

// This consumer exists so the production deadcode pass sees the library's whole
// public surface reached from a main package. Every exported symbol is called
// here; anything added to the API and not added here turns the pass red, which
// is the point — an export nobody can reach is dead weight in a published
// module.

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()

	problems, err := standardconfig.NewProblems(problem.LocalErrorPortal(), standardconfig.ProblemTypes()...)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	_ = problems.Registry()
	if _, err := problems.Catalog(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	_ = problems.Raise(standardconfig.ProblemConnectionUnknown, "unreachable", nil)
	_ = standardconfig.ProblemVersion
	_ = standardconfig.ProblemConnectionAmbiguous
	_ = standardconfig.ProblemConnectionKeyInvalid
	_ = standardconfig.ProblemPresetUnknown

	_ = standardconfig.ValidKey(standardconfig.UppercaseKeyPattern)
	_ = standardconfig.ValidConnectionName(standardconfig.ConnectionNamePattern)
	_ = standardconfig.PresetNames()
	_ = standardconfig.Schemas()
	_ = standardconfig.PostgresSchema()
	_ = standardconfig.CacheSchema()
	_ = standardconfig.KvSchema()
	_ = standardconfig.StorageSchema()
	if _, err := standardconfig.SchemaFor(problems, standardconfig.PostgresBlockKey); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	postgres := testhelper.FakePostgres(testhelper.DefaultKey)
	cache := testhelper.FakeCache(testhelper.DefaultKey)
	kv := testhelper.FakeKv(testhelper.DefaultKey)
	storage := testhelper.FakeStorage(testhelper.DefaultKey)
	_ = standardconfig.Keys(postgres)
	if _, err := standardconfig.Named(problems, cache, testhelper.DefaultKey); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	_ = standardconfig.ValidateKeys(problems, standardconfig.KvBlockKey, kv)
	_ = standardconfig.PostgresBlock(postgres)
	_ = standardconfig.CacheBlock(cache)
	_ = standardconfig.KvBlock(kv)
	_ = standardconfig.StorageBlock(storage)
	_ = standardconfig.PoolSizing{}
	_ = standardconfig.PostgresEntry{}
	_ = standardconfig.RedisEntry{}
	_ = standardconfig.CacheEntry{}
	_ = standardconfig.KvEntry{}
	_ = standardconfig.StorageEntry{}

	var t testhelper.TestingT = &testing.T{}
	testhelper.RequireUppercaseKeys(t, postgres)
	testhelper.RequireConnectionNames(t, cache)
	_ = testhelper.RequireEntry(t, storage, testhelper.DefaultKey)
	_ = testhelper.RequireStarted(t, &testhelper.StartedCache{}, nil)

	var runtime testhelper.Runtime = testhelper.DockerRuntime{}
	fmt.Println(reach(ctx, runtime))
}

// reach drives the container glue and the bucket helper. It is never run: a
// deadcode consumer only has to make the surface reachable, and starting four
// containers to prove that would be absurd.
func reach(ctx context.Context, runtime testhelper.Runtime) error {
	startedPostgres, err := testhelper.StartPostgres(ctx, testhelper.PostgresOptions{
		Image: testhelper.DefaultPostgresImage, Runtime: runtime,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	startedCache, err := testhelper.StartCache(ctx, testhelper.RedisOptions{
		Image: testhelper.DefaultRedisImage, Runtime: runtime,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	startedKv, err := testhelper.StartKv(ctx, testhelper.RedisOptions{Runtime: runtime})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	startedStorage, err := testhelper.StartStorage(ctx, testhelper.StorageOptions{
		Image: testhelper.DefaultStorageImage, Runtime: runtime,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := testhelper.CreateBucket(ctx, startedStorage.Entry); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var container testhelper.Container = startedPostgres.Container
	if _, err := container.Host(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := container.Port(ctx, "5432/tcp"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := container.Terminate(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, terminate := range []func(context.Context) error{
		startedPostgres.Terminate, startedCache.Terminate,
		startedKv.Terminate, startedStorage.Terminate,
	} {
		if err := terminate(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
